apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Generated in the Atomberg Home app under Developer Options.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Generated in the Atomberg Home app under Developer Options.

useCloudOnly.title: Use cloud API only
useCloudOnly.description: By default the plugin sends commands directly to the fan over your LAN (UDP/5600) when reachable, and only falls back to the cloud API. Enable this if Homebridge can't see the fans' subnet (Docker bridge networking, VLAN isolation, etc.) — every command will then count against the 100 calls/day Atomberg quota.

legacy5Speed.title: Legacy 5-speed fans
legacy5Speed.description: Enable for pre-2022 Atomberg fans that only support 5 speed levels (Renesa, Studio). The HomeKit rotation slider will quantize to 1..5 instead of 1..6.
